# `vl show`

Show a snapshot's metadata and diff

```text
vl show [OPTIONS] [REV]
```

Arguments:

| | |
|---|---|
| `<REV>` | Snapshot to show (default: `@`) |

Options:

| | |
|---|---|
| `--stat` | Only list changed paths |
